thread:
sasha: Quick follow-up from the midnight incident — we need a concise remediation plan for rollout controls. I want ownership and timelines for: auto-rollback, blast-radius gating, and recurring pattern detection. Can folks volunteer?
lee: I'll take auto-rollback rules. Plan to prototype in staging this week.
marta: I'll lead blast-radius gating. Want to draft policy doc and small experiments.
deploy-bot: [automated] deploy 2026-03-22T23:45:12 succeeded :white_check_mark:
lee: @sasha quick q — for auto-rollback, are we comfortable with the criteria being error-rate + p95 latency spike? Or want more signals?
sasha: error-rate + p95 + a delta on successful calls. Keep it conservative initially.
ana: I'll help add synthetic traffic checks to make the detection less noisy.
sam: I'll own the recurring-pattern detection pipeline (logs -> anomaly detector). ETA: 2 sprints.
marta: For blast-radius: propose limiting new flags to 10% users by default and auto-escalate quarantine at 5% error impact. Drafting in #docs; will post short PR by Friday.
sasha: Great. Let's map to concrete action items and owners:
- Auto-rollback prototype (lee) — staging test by Thu, canary rules by next Mon.
- Blast-radius policy + enforcement (marta + ana) — policy doc Fri, enforcement work WIP next sprint.
- Synthetic checks integration (ana) — helper scripts + thresholds by Tue.
- Recurring incident detection (sam) — pipeline design doc by end of sprint.
- Postmortem followthrough board (sasha) — create sprintboard and tag tasks in JIRA by EOD.
ana: I can pair with marta on enforcement, esp. the feature-flag SDK changes.
lee: Proposed config snippet for canary rule:
```
canary:
  percent: 5
  monitoring_signals:
    - error_rate_threshold: 0.02
    - p95_latency_delta: 1.5x
  rollback_action: "automated"
```
marta: @sasha should we require two signals to trigger rollback? one signal may be flaky.
sasha: Yes — require two signals in first rollout. We'll lower to one after reliable synthetic checks.
product-ops: Heads up — customers on Dedicated may want different defaults. We should surface config per customer.
sam: Noted — will add per-customer override to design doc.
lee: I'll open a draft PR with the canary config and add tests. tag me @lee.
sasha: Thanks. Can everyone add their JIRA links to the sprintboard after you create tasks? I'll run weekly quick sync until items land.
ana: Added task ENG-4523 for SDK changes.
marta: Created policy draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4530 :eyes: 
sasha: Awesome. Next check-in Wednesday 10am. If anyone hits blockers ping me or @oncall. :thumbsup:
oncall: Acknowledged — standby for assist if rollback thresholds fire during testing.
sam: FYI I'll add a retro card for recurring pattern types we saw (feature-flag misconfig, rollout velocity, monitoring gaps).
lee: LGTM. Let's keep the initial rollouts small and instrumented.
sasha: closing — will update the sprintboard and follow up with calendar invite. Thanks everyone. :pray:
